279	// reportCreatedDefaults says the same thing about a fresh scaffold in every
280	// mode — one sentence, one place, so the three call sites cannot drift apart
281	// the way "default" / "generic default" / "working default" already had.
282	func reportCreatedDefaults(errW io.Writer, n int, mode runnerSetupMode) {
283		next := "run `entire runner setup -y` to tailor them to this repo"
284		switch mode {

298	func resolveRunnerSetupMode(ctx context.Context, errW io.Writer, opts runnerSetupOptions, haveRunners bool) (runnerSetupMode, error) {

**1. Stream hygiene — the fix that changes what you see**

`--print-prompt` does create the six default runner files (your agent needs them to write templates into), and `createDefaultRunners` printed its six `created …` lines to the *same* writer the prompt then went to: stdout.
